source: 100 MeV proton point source at z = -0.5 mm, direction +z, no spread
geometry: G4_WATER box 60 x 60 x 100 mm (z from 0 to 100 mm) with a 1 mm daughter slab at z = 30-31 mm
cuts: 0.1 mm production cuts; Geant4 EM opt4 default step limits; NO hadronic physics
scorers: EnergyDeposit along z, 200 bins of 0.5 mm (whole box)
EnergyDeposit across x in the slab at 30-31 mm depth, 120 bins of 0.5 mm
units: MeV summed over histories (native csv headers)
rationale: Independent Monte Carlo evidence for electromagnetic proton transport (range, straggling width, lateral spread) without nuclear interactions; used to evaluate the reference backend of V2-004 (PHY-PROTON-WATER partial evidence)
